Package org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockItems

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItems
public final class BedrockItems extends Object
Every item type of Bedrock 26.60, the newest bundled release. The constants are resolved against the newest data of Paletter.bundled() on first use; referencing them loads nothing. Variants that differ by damage (potions, banners, ...) are BedrockItemType.variant(int): the bundled data does not name them.

Constants are added when Bedrock adds items (binary compatible). Items Bedrock removes stay, deprecated, and resolve to their fallback; renamed items keep their old constant, deprecated, as an alias of the new one.

The @since of a constant is the bundled Bedrock release it first appears in, without an experiment toggle (decided from the BDS captures in data/bds); 26.40 is the oldest bundled release, so it may be older. @Education marks content BDS only offers to worlds with Education Edition features, which isEducation() of the type answers at runtime.

Since:
1.0.0
